records.source: Really? That's surprising.$8#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: 真的嗎？真令人驚訝。$8#$b#我一輩子都住在山谷裡，卻從沒真正做過值得銘記的事。我想去冒險！$8

records.source: I see...$8
records.translation: 我明白了……$8

records.source: Yea... I guess you would be one to appreciate this somber ambience.
records.translation: 是啊……我想你應該懂得欣賞這種陰鬱的氛圍。

records.source: ...That's true.$8
records.translation: ……確實如此。$8

records.source: Yeah... I guess my own life is okay...$s
records.translation: 是啊……看來我自己的人生還算不錯……$s

records.source: I would feel better if I could believe that...#$b#But I don't.$s
records.translation: 如果能相信那種說法，我會好受一點……#$b#但我不相信。$s

records.source: @... I'm alright.$8
...okay.$8
I guess when you have something to lose, it's normal to be afraid...$l
records.translation: 我想，當你有珍惜的東西可能失去時，害怕很正常……$l

records.source: ...Um, okay. Sorry.$9
records.translation: ……嗯，好吧。抱歉。$9

records.source: Summer's here. It's not really my favorite season.#$e#The air is so muggy I feel like I'm floating in soup.
records.translation: 夏天到了。這其實不是我最喜歡的季節。#$e#空氣溼熱得讓我覺得自己漂在湯裡。

records.source: My pet guinea pig, David, just hates this hot weather. He's fussy.
records.translation: 我的寵物天竺鼠大衛非常討厭這種炎熱天氣。牠一直鬧脾氣。

records.source: The air is so thick with honey and nectar all summer. I almost feel dizzy.$u
records.translation: 整個夏天，空氣裡都充滿濃厚的蜂蜜和花蜜氣息。幾乎讓我頭暈。$u

records.source: Have you decorated your house at all? That's what I'd be doing if I had a house.
records.translation: 你有裝飾自己的房子嗎？如果我有房子，一定會忙著做這件事。

records.source: I went to the beach last night, after dark... Sometimes you can see strange lights bobbing over the sea.#$e#Or maybe that was just a dream I had... It doesn't feel real anymore.
records.translation: 昨晚天黑後，我去了海灘……有時能看到奇怪的光芒在海面上起伏。#$e#也可能那只是一場夢……現在已經感覺不真實了。

records.source: If I knew how to use a sword I would be exploring those caves by the mountain lake right now. It's probably nice and cool in there.
records.translation: 如果會用劍，我現在一定正在探索山中湖泊旁的那些洞穴。裡面大概涼快又舒服。

records.source: Ew, I hope I don't get a tan this summer.$s
records.translation: 呃，希望今年夏天不會曬黑。$s

records.source: I kind of wish I had a cat. Unfortunately, my Dad is allergic to pretty much everything.
records.translation: 我有點希望自己能養隻貓。可惜爸爸幾乎對所有東西都過敏。

records.source: I'm looking forward to fall... the cool mountain breeze, the swirling red petals, the smell of mushrooms... *sigh*
records.translation: 我很期待秋天……涼爽的山風、旋舞的紅色花瓣、蘑菇的氣味……*嘆氣*

records.source: Do you ever get an urge to go exploring, @?#$q 25/26 summer_Sun_old#Okay... pretend you just won a free vacation. Where would you go?#$r 25 0 Sun_25#The beach#$r 26 30 Sun_26#In a dark cave#$r 26 30 Sun_26#The old, gnarled forest#$r 25 0 Sun_25#Joja Mega-Mall
records.translation: @，你會突然很想去探索嗎？#$q 25/26 summer_Sun_old#好……假裝你剛贏得一次免費度假。你會去哪裡？#$r 25 0 Sun_25#海灘#$r 26 30 Sun_26#黑暗的洞穴#$r 26 30 Sun_26#古老而扭曲的森林#$r 25 0 Sun_25#Joja 超級購物中心

records.source: $p 25#I do... but you probably wouldn't like the places I'm thinking about...|Maybe we'll be neighbors someday. I think we both have similar, weird tastes.$h
records.translation: $p 25#我會……但我想到的那些地方，你大概不會喜歡……|也許有一天我們會成為鄰居。我覺得我們的怪品味很相似。$h

records.source: Huh. I think that would get old fast.
records.translation: 嗯。我覺得那很快就會膩。

records.source: Yea! That sounds wonderful.$h
records.translation: 對啊！聽起來太棒了。$h

records.source: I would love to live in an old farmhouse like you.#$b#The creak of a floorboard, the slow plumes of dust whispering through the rafters... There's something special about an old building, isn't there?
records.translation: 我很想像你一樣住在老農舍裡。#$b#地板的吱嘎聲、灰塵緩緩飄過椽木的低語……老建築有種特別的魅力，對吧？

records.source: You're an interesting ${guy^lady}$, @. I'm glad you moved here.$h
records.translation: 你是個很有意思的${guy^lady}$，@。很高興你搬來這裡。$h

records.source: I'm actually enjoying myself this summer.$h#$e#It's funny how quickly one's outlook can change.
records.translation: 其實今年夏天我過得很開心。$h#$e#人的看法竟能如此迅速地改變，真有意思。

records.source: I used to think Pelican Town was kinda drab, but lately I'm starting to love some things about it.$h
records.translation: 以前我覺得鵜鶘鎮有點沉悶，但最近開始喜歡上這裡的一些事物了。$h

records.source: Wow, you look nice today.#$e#I mean, that summer air is really good for the complexion, isn't it?... heh...$l
records.translation: 哇，你今天很好看。#$e#我是說，夏天的空氣真的很養膚，對吧？……嘿……$l

records.source: Do you ever get lonely on your farm?
records.translation: 你在農場會覺得寂寞嗎？

records.source: Ah... Fall's here!$h#$e#I was getting so tired of summer.
records.translation: 啊……秋天到了！$h#$e#我都快受夠夏天了。

records.source: I need to stretch my legs and get some fresh air today.
records.translation: 今天得出去走走，呼吸點新鮮空氣。

records.source: $d joja#I try to help out in the shop on most days. Business has been pretty bad since the Joja Mart opened, though.|Ever since Joja Mart shut down we've been doing great at the shop!$h
records.translation: $d joja#大多數日子我都會試著在店裡幫忙。不過自從 Joja 超市開張後，生意一直很差。|自從 Joja 超市關門後，我們店裡的生意一直很棒！$h

records.source: I can't wait to see some pumpkins this year.$h#$e#The spirit's eve festival happens at the end of the season. It's pretty low-key compared to what you'd see in Zuzu City, but for a small town like this it's a lot of fun.
records.translation: 我迫不及待想看到今年的南瓜了。$h#$e#季末會舉辦萬靈節。和祖祖市的活動相比相當低調，但對這樣的小鎮來說非常有趣。

records.source: #$1 AbigailHAND#Last night I dreamt that my left hand had turned into a gigantic %noun. Does that mean anything?#$e#%Abigail doesn't seem to be interested in talking right now.
records.translation: #$1 AbigailHAND#昨晚我夢見左手變成了一個巨大的%noun。這代表什麼嗎？#$e#%Abigail現在似乎沒興趣說話。

records.source: $d cc#I can't believe you fixed up that old Community Center all by yourself. I'm really impressed.|Do you have any scarecrows on your farm?
records.translation: $d cc#真不敢相信你獨自修好了那座舊社區中心。實在令人佩服。|你的農場有稻草人嗎？

records.source: Hmm... what should I do tonight?#$q 27/28 fall_Sun_old#I was thinking about dyeing my hair again... what do you think?#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Dye it black.#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Why not blonde?#$r 27 20 Sun_WildColor#How about bubblegum pink?#$r 28 0 Sun_28#I like your hair just the way it is!
records.translation: 嗯……今晚該做什麼？#$q 27/28 fall_Sun_old#我在考慮再次染髮……你覺得呢？#$r 27 10 Sun_27#染成黑色。#$r 27 10 Sun_27#金色怎麼樣？#$r 27 20 Sun_WildColor#泡泡糖粉紅色如何？#$r 28 0 Sun_28#我喜歡你現在的髮色！

records.source: $p 27#I was going to dye my hair but then I decided against it.|Yes? What is it?
records.translation: $p 27#我本來要染頭髮，但後來決定不染了。|怎麼了？有事嗎？

records.source: I guess that's a pretty safe choice, huh?#$e#I'll think about it.
records.translation: 我想這是個相當保險的選擇，對吧？#$e#我會考慮。

records.source: Of course that's what you'd say.$u
records.translation: 你果然會這麼說。$u

records.source: You're always good for a laugh.$h
records.translation: 你總能逗我笑。$h

records.source: Are you growing pumpkins on your farm this year?#$e#Save one for me!$h
records.translation: 今年你的農場有種南瓜嗎？#$e#替我留一顆！$h

records.source: I may fight with my parents a lot, but I know they're just looking out for me. They're doing what they think is best.$s#$b#I dunno why I'm saying this to you. Don't tell anyone.$8
records.translation: 我也許常和爸媽吵架，但知道他們只是在照顧我。他們只是做自認最好的事。$s#$b#不知道為什麼要對你說這些。別告訴任何人。$8

records.source: Hi.$h#$e#Your hair looks cool today... did you do something different?
records.translation: 嗨。$h#$e#你今天的頭髮看起來很酷……做了什麼改變嗎？

records.source: You know, I could actually see myself becoming a farmer some day...#$e#But how would that ever happen? *chuckle*$l
records.translation: 你知道嗎，我其實能想像自己有一天成為農夫……#$e#但那怎麼可能發生呢？*輕笑*$l

records.source: I had an interesting dream last night, with you in it.#$e#It was a good dream.$h
records.translation: 昨晚我做了一場有趣的夢，裡面有你。#$e#那是一場好夢。$h

records.source: I wish the season lasted a little longer.$8#$e#When the wind really picks up, I almost feel like a kid again.
records.translation: 真希望這個季節能再久一點。$8#$e#風真正颳起來時，我幾乎覺得自己又成了小孩子。

records.source: I usually feel lonely this time of year, but not anymore.$l#$e#@, what are your plans for the future?
records.translation: 每年這個時候我通常會覺得寂寞，但現在不會了。$l#$e#@，你對未來有什麼計畫？

records.source: Well, fall is over...$s#$e#But I like winter, too!$h
records.translation: 嗯，秋天結束了……$s#$e#不過我也喜歡冬天！$h

records.source: It's just too cold to go outside much.#$e#But I do enjoy building a snowgoon.$h
records.translation: 天氣實在太冷，不適合常常外出。#$e#不過我確實很喜歡堆雪怪人。$h

records.source: Doesn't a steaming hot cup of cocoa sound good right now?
records.translation: 現在來一杯熱氣騰騰的可可，不是很棒嗎？

records.source: Hi. Is it boring to be a farmer during the winter?
records.translation: 嗨。冬天當農夫會很無聊嗎？

records.source: I'm definitely going to enter the egg hunt tomorrow. Are you?
records.translation: 我明天一定會參加找彩蛋活動。你呢？

records.source: Well, tomorrow is the flower dance. Dancing is alright, but they make me wear this stupid white dress...$s
records.translation: 嗯，明天就是花舞節。跳舞還行，但他們逼我穿這件蠢兮兮的白色洋裝……$s

records.source: I'm looking forward to making a snow man tomorrow.
records.translation: 我很期待明天堆雪人。

records.source: Will I see you tomorrow at the Spirit's Eve festival? Look for me in the haunted maze.$h
records.translation: 明天會在萬靈節見到你嗎？來鬧鬼迷宮找我。$h

records.source: Everyone's excited for the Luau tomorrow. Maybe a little nervous, too, considering the Governor will be here.
records.translation: 大家都很期待明天的夏威夷宴會。想到州長會來，也許還有點緊張。

records.source: You can't miss tomorrow's festival. It's one of the most beautiful wonders of the valley.
records.translation: 明天的節慶絕對不能錯過。那是山谷裡最美麗的奇景之一。

records.source: I'm going to eat so much cranberry sauce tomorrow.$h
records.translation: 我明天要吃一大堆蔓越莓醬。$h

records.source: Another year is almost over.#$e#It goes by so fast, doesn't it?$s
records.translation: 又一年快要結束了。#$e#時間過得真快，對吧？$s

records.source: One thing I've learned living here... everyone stares at you if you look different.
records.translation: 住在這裡讓我明白一件事……只要看起來與眾不同，所有人都會盯著你。

records.source: It's the weekend!#$e#That means I can play twice as many video games.$h#$e#Bye.
records.translation: 週末到了！#$e#這表示我可以玩兩倍的電玩。$h#$e#再見。

records.source: Oh, hello.#$q 29/30 winter_Sun_old#I made these two drawings. What do you think?#$r 29 20 Sun_29#I like the jungle island and the tiger.#$r 30 5 Sun_30#I like the orc with the battleaxe.#$r 29 -50 Sun_Bad#I don't like either of them.
records.translation: 喔，你好。#$q 29/30 winter_Sun_old#我畫了這兩幅畫。你覺得如何？#$r 29 20 Sun_29#我喜歡叢林島嶼和老虎。#$r 30 5 Sun_30#我喜歡拿戰斧的獸人。#$r 29 -50 Sun_Bad#兩幅都不喜歡。

records.source: $p 29#Remember those drawings I showed you a while ago? I accidentally threw them away.$s|Remember that drawing I showed you with the orc? I entered it into an online contest and won 50g!$h
records.translation: $p 29#還記得前陣子給你看的那些畫嗎？我不小心把它們扔掉了。$s|還記得我給你看過的那幅獸人畫嗎？我拿它參加線上比賽，贏了50g！$h

records.source: Oh yeah? I guess that makes sense.
records.translation: 真的嗎？我想這很合理。

records.source: I'm glad. It's embarrassing to share your art with others. But I think you and I are on the same page.
records.translation: 真高興。和別人分享自己的作品很令人難為情。不過我覺得你和我想法一致。

records.source: Rude! Why would you hurt my feelings like that? You're so insensitive!$s
records.translation: 沒禮貌！為什麼要那樣傷我的心？你太不體貼了！$s

records.source: Hi. If you're ever bored, you can always hang out in my room.#$e#As long as I'm not changing, of course!
records.translation: 嗨。如果覺得無聊，隨時可以來我房間待著。#$e#當然，前提是我沒有在換衣服！

records.source: It's so cold, I wish we had a hot cup of cocoa to share.$h
records.translation: 天氣好冷，真希望我們能一起喝杯熱可可。$h

records.source: I've been daydreaming a lot lately...#$e#Oh! You want to know what it's about? Well...$u#$b#...It's a secret.$h
records.translation: 最近我常常做白日夢……#$e#喔！你想知道夢些什麼？嗯……$u#$b#……這是祕密。$h

records.source: Another year is almost over...#$b#But this was a really good year, don't you think?$h
records.translation: 又一年快要結束了……#$b#但今年真的很美好，你不覺得嗎？$h

records.source: It must be nice not having crops to worry about this time of year.#$e#And that means you can hang out with me more often!$h
records.translation: 每年這個時候不用操心作物，一定很輕鬆。#$e#這也表示你能更常和我一起玩！$h

records.source: @, there's something I want to tell you...#$e#It's just... um... well... your boots! They, uh...look really clean... *gulp*#$e#That's all... *sigh*$s
records.translation: @，我有件事想告訴你……#$e#只是……嗯……那個……你的靴子！它們，呃……看起來非常乾淨……*吞口水*#$e#就這樣……*嘆氣*$s

records.source: I can't trust a person who doesn't like animals...#$e#Oh, don't worry! I know you're an animal lover!$h
records.translation: 我無法信任不喜歡動物的人……#$e#喔，別擔心！我知道你熱愛動物！$h
